conbody.p: The selected artifact opens on the right (on a phone, as a screen of its own: ‹ Requirements at its top goes back to the list). Its header carries the ref, the status, quality and priority chips, Edit, and a ⋯ menu with History and Archive. Straight under the title is the artifact's own text (with Show impact → on a requirement), then one line of facts: its type, owner, verification method, the releases it is planned for (when it sets its own and the project plans target releases, such as MVP onwards), version and when it last changed. Details opens them as a table with its UID. Then comes the review step it can take next (Submit for review, Approve, …).

ul.li: Trace lists every artifact this one is linked to, ↑ above and ↓ below, with the link's type; a suspect link is marked in yellow. Click one to go to it.
Verification shows how many of the tests verifying it pass, a pass / fail / blocked bar, each test with its latest result, and the requirement's rollup.

A design item also shows what it satisfies and Verified through: the test cases that verify those requirements, each with its last result (tests verify requirements, so this is the evidence that reaches the item).
Below them are the attributes, the figures and the full list of traceability links, where a link can be deleted.

conbody.p: On a phone the artifact ends in a bar under your thumb: Comment scrolls to its History, where the comment box is, and the review step forward (Submit for review, Approve) is the blue button beside it. While an artifact is open, the app's own bottom bar steps aside for this one.
